about_the_game:
Show off your love of Forgive Me Father 2, with the Forgive Me Father 2 Supporter Pack! In return, you will receive a bunch of goodies related to the game and other rewards to help you stand out among the fans of the game.

This is not a typical DLC; it does not impact the gameplay experience or add new content to the game. Instead, by picking up the pack, you’ll be supporting the developers on their journey, helping them bring even more insanity into the world. With this unearthly contribution, you’re not only showing your status as the most devoted cultist of them all, but you’re also keeping the madness alive.

To show our eternal gratitude, as a way to say “THANK YOU,” we have prepared the following rewards for any cultists who purchase the Forgive Me Father 2 Supporter Pack:

  • Ready to print Postcard

  • A set of exclusive digital Stickers

  • A set of exclusive digital Wallpapers

  • Exclusive Supporter role on the Forgive Me Father Discord server

You can find the digital goodies in the main folder of the game, typically:

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Forgive Me Father 2\FMF2

Instructions to activate the exclusive Discord role can be found on the official Forgive Me Father Discord:

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is stylized Lovecraftian old-school FPS set in a comic book style world with a lot of opponents in a 3D environment. 

This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages: Frequent Violence or Gore. Violence against stylized human-like characters.
